status_rule: pass iff every claim of class headline, approximate, summary or practicality agrees at its printed precision and every check holds (the checks include the recomputed G2.85-G2.94 verdicts). Class 'secondary' = supporting prose figures outside the two section 9.23 tables and the main claims; they are recomputed and listed, a disagreement is reported under 'errata' and needs an additive erratum, and it does not decide the status because no table cell, headline range or registered verdict depends on it.
